cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make It Official
cards.instruction: Recruit someone by giving them a title, role, or ceremonial duty that makes participation feel binding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've made you Keeper of the Festival Lantern.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only said I'd hold it while you tied your shoe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. An excellent probationary performance. Here's your badge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Until you find a qualified successor. The lantern must never be abandoned.

mechanism: A reclassifies a brief favor as a supervised ceremonial appointment, imposing a qualified handover to make B keep participating.
confusable: D169 shares outcome responsibility; D175 makes a title and ceremony themselves feel binding.
comparison: An accidental lantern appointment differs from negotiating a patron's acceptable public duty.
seedUse: Keep shoe-tying favor, badge and successor; add actual handling and handover corrections.
